subject: GreenWave initial access orchestration & key provisioning
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: Helen Brooks <helen.brooks@healthit-consult.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: GreenWave initial access orchestration & key provisioning

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our implementation checklist, I wanted to share a concise access plan so your engineers can get a sandbox tenant and API keys while procurement finalizes the PO. Attached: a simple invite matrix (CSV) and a short API key primer (PDF).

High-level plan (can iterate):
- Day 0 (today): Create a sandbox project in your account namespaced as gw-sbx-2027 and provision a Redwood service account for integrations.
- Day 1: Invite pilot users (2-3 product + 1 security) and enable Scoped API keys with 90-day TTL for the pilot.
- Day 3–5: Run sample traffic, validate latency and embedding outputs; troubleshoot with our CS engineer.

Two quick asks for your team to confirm:
1) Do you want the service account to be created by our team and handed off, or do you prefer to create and share the credentials?
2) Do you plan to use SSO mapping for pilot users or invite direct email users to the tenant?

If helpful I can drop commands and an env var list in a follow-up. Suggested time for a short provisioning call: today 2:00–3:00pm PT or tomorrow 10:00–11:00am PT.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: greenwave_invite_matrix.csv (CSV: name,role,email,environment), api_key_primer.pdf (3-page primer)

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@greenwavehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@greenwavehealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GreenWave initial access orchestration & key provisioning

Hi Grace —

Thanks, the plan looks good. Quick answers:
- Procurement loop: procurement@greenwavehealth.com will need the SOW and an invoice before PO issuance. I copied them.
- For the pilot, we'd prefer Redwood to create the service account and provide credentials to our security team via the secure artifact link you choose. We'll do SSO mapping for production but direct invites are fine for the pilot.

One more ask: Can the scoped API keys be limited to the sandbox project and marked non-exportable? Also confirm whether keys can be configured to rotate automatically (we prefer 30–90 day rotation).

I'll schedule a 30-minute provisioning call for tomorrow at 10am PT unless that conflicts with your team. Helen from HealthIT Consulting (cc'd) will help with SSO mapping later in the rollout.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Product Integrations | GreenWave Health
samira.k@greenwavehealth.com

Subject: Fwd: GreenWave initial access orchestration & key provisioning — internal tasking

Team — forwarding GreenWave confirmation. Please see minimal task breakdown so we can hit tomorrow's 10:00am PT call with concrete artifacts. I'm keeping the externals on the loop for transparency.

Tasks (owner / ETA):
- Dev: Create sandbox project gw-sbx-2027, enable tenant, create a service account named redwood-gw-svc. Please provision one Scoped API key (sandbox-only, read+infer) with 90-day default TTL and add metadata tags: "greenwave:sbx" and "deal:GW-2027-0842". Send the secure artifact link to Grace when done. (ETA: today 15:30 PT)
- Marissa: Prepare a short onboarding playbook (1–2 pages) with the invite flow, SSO notes, and sample cURL snippets. Include the exact env var names we'll request (REDWOOD_PROJECT, REDWOOD_API_KEY). Attach api_key_primer.pdf and the CSV invite matrix. (ETA: today 13:00 PT)
- Soojin: Verify the key rotation policy and confirm whether we can support automatic rotation to 30/60/90 days for this deal. If automatic rotation is not available, draft recommended rotation cadence and a reminder workflow. (ETA: today 14:30 PT)

Notes for Dev: if you create a one-time API token for the artifact, mark it expiring after 48 hours and reference the secure Drive folder I shared. For audit evidence, capture the service account creation log and include the KMS key id used for envelope encryption (if you use it).

I'll own the provisioning call agenda and finalize the DocuSign link request for the SOW so procurement has what they need.

-Grace

> Onwards, please paste command snippets as plain text in the thread so Samira's team can copy them during the call.

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GreenWave initial access orchestration & key provisioning — internal tasking

Grace / Team —

Done: created project gw-sbx-2027 and service account redwood-gw-svc in our tenant for this customer sandbox. I generated a scoped API key (stub below) and uploaded the encrypted artifact to the Drive folder linked in the metadata.

API key (stub): rwk_live_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Note: This is a placeholder in thread. The real key is in the secure artifact (encrypted). I set TTL = 90 days and added tags: greenwave:sbx, deal:GW-2027-0842.

Commands I ran (for Samira's engineers):
1) Create project (internal console): redwood projects create --name gw-sbx-2027 --region us-west1
2) Create service account: redwood iam service-accounts create redwood-gw-svc --project gw-sbx-2027
3) Create scoped key: redwood keys create --sa redwood-gw-svc --scopes infer,embeddings --ttl 90d --tag greenwave:sbx

Soojin — please confirm rotation options; I left rotation set to manual with reminders if auto-rotate isn't available. I captured the audit log id: AL-20270820-77a3 (Drive: audit-logs/AL-20270820-77a3.txt).

Next: I'll drop a short runbook snippet in the Drive and be on the 10:00am PT call.

-Dev

Attachments referenced: sow-draft.docx (in Drive), audit-logs/AL-20270820-77a3.txt

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I confirmed receipt of the secure artifact and shared the stub with our security team; they'll pull the real key from the Drive ahead of the call. The command snippets are perfect.

Procurement — Helen / procurement team, we expect a SOW and invoice from Redwood; Grace is our Redwood contact. Grace, can you send the DocuSign link for the SOW and an invoice template so procurement can proceed with PO issuance?

Call confirmed: Tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda: 1) Validate project + keys 2) Run sample request 3) Confirm SSO timeline for production 4) Procurement next steps.

See you tomorrow.

Best,
Samira
